name: Paloma
description: Paloma is a benchmark to measure language model fit across 546 English and code domains, moving beyond traditional perplexity evaluation on monolithic data. It includes datasets from top subreddits and programming languages to assess model performance on diverse domain distributions.
reputation: A relatively new but well-regarded benchmark for evaluating language-model fit across many heterogeneous English and code domains, especially for moving beyond single-number perplexity on monolithic corpora.
notes: Includes 6 baseline 1B LMs for fair comparison and introduces new datasets from Reddit and GitHub.
